reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Butler chat priority and guidance
reason: Two Python cases cover Butler capability discovery, project-scoped chat paging, pin and flag writes, invalid input, stale revisions, and durable read-back. Two product-knowledge cases cover the updated guidance digest and Chroma synchronization. The eight collected real-Core browser profiles exercise the Butler tool journey and saved sidebar state after refresh at desktop, compact, Android-sized Chromium, and iPhone-sized WebKit viewports.
exclusions: No production frontend or native source changed, so no frontend or native tests are selected. Unrelated Python and Playwright journeys are excluded. The browser profiles emulate mobile devices; physical Safari was not available.
